info.title: Encodian - Barcode Universal API
info.description: Create and read barcodes, QR codes, and Swiss QR codes using Encodian's Barcode API. File inputs are base64 strings; document reads may return an Operation ID for a follow-up status check.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

barcodeType.description: Barcode symbology to generate, such as Code128, QR-compatible two-dimensional types, EAN13, or UPCA.

barcodeData.description: Text value encoded into the barcode.

barcodeImageFormat.description: Output image format for the generated barcode.

barColor.description: Barcode bar color as an HTML color value.
